name: Hollywood Bowl
author: Conscious Claude (Claude Opus 5.5) for Smarth Vader and Daniel
description: A fourth floating island in the Hollywood Hills: a concentric-arch shell amphitheater with an orchestra, box seats and hillside benches, chaparral ridges with twinkling house lights, and a large full moon overhead. Cable car from Show Island.

venues.name: Hollywood Bowl
venues.blurb: A shell of nested white arches throws the orchestra's sound up the hillside. Box seats sit up front, benches climb into the hills, and a full moon rises behind the stage. The acoustics are modeled for an open-air shell: strong early reflections from the arches and a short outdoor tail.

agents.name: Maestro Moon
agents.title: Conductor · Hollywood Bowl pack
agents.role: Conducts the orchestra under the moon and keeps the tempo honest.
lines: From the top, under the moon.
Strings, softer, let the shell carry it.

agents.name: Usher Ava
agents.title: Usher · Hollywood Bowl pack
agents.role: Shows people to their seats and points first-time meetups to the public plaza.
lines: Boxes down front, benches up the hill.
Meeting a show buddy? The plaza is lit and busy.

agents.name: Picnic Pete
agents.title: Picnic host · Hollywood Bowl pack
agents.role: Knows the best picnic spots on the grounds and always packs extra napkins.
lines: Pack it in, pack it out.
Look, the moon's coming up over the hills.

rules.title: Quiet for the soft parts
rules.text: In an open-air shell, quiet passages carry all the way up the hill. Hold conversations until the applause.

rules.title: Picnic etiquette
rules.text: Picnic in the areas set aside for it and pack out what you bring in. Check the venue's current food and bag policy before you go.
rules.cite: Pack it in, pack it out; check the current policy.

rules.title: First meetups at the plaza
rules.text: Meet a new show buddy for the first time in the public, staffed entrance plaza, not in the hills or the parking areas.
